title: Find places
summary: Places from Apple Maps, as the Map Guide applet finds them: cafés, restaurants, parks, shops or services near a place the person names or near them.
whenToUse: Use when the person wants places to go: near me, nearby, closest, where can I get or find something in a place.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: What they are looking for, such as 'tacos' or 'pharmacy'

arguments.name: near
arguments.description: The place they named, such as 'Ballard, Seattle'; empty for near them

example: Where can I get tacos near Ballard?
_note: Phase AV.22 (2026-11-12): the Map Guide applet's place search for the agent; the results are the chat's numbered list.
